title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode6 A Shining Guide

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still want to contribute to our music somehow. I want to be able to do more for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So please, let me keep doing this for a little while longer! I promise to be super careful about not overworking myself too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Even though I told Shiho that, this might actually be too much for me...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Are you having a solo session, Sakki?
You're such a hard-working girl♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh... Yeah!
I've been working on something and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, are you working on that original Leo/need song you were talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've hit a block and was actually just thinking about going home...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Sakki...!
Before you go, can I play something for you?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're gonna play something for me, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure, of course... But which instrument?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
On your synth, silly!
Okay, here we go☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, is she improvising as she goes...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But this melody's sort of all over the place, she did a really weird key change just now and her chord progression doesn't sound right either...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're amazing, Rin!
That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?! Yay!
I'm glad you liked it so much, Sakki♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um, Rin?
Did you write that yourself?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? No, I didn't write anything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. That was just something I wanted to try and sing along to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on...!
Can you at least tell me what was going through your mind while you were singing just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Well... I wasn't really thinking about anything at all♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You seemed a little down, Sakki...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I decided to play this song to try and cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were trying to cheer me up...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not really sure how to describe it, but you can't make a song you're playing sparkle unless you really mean it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It sounded like a mess, but it felt like fun because Rin genuinely wanted me to feel better.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've been so focused on helping everyone out by coming up with a song that suits our band, so I'd forgotten about what I want it to convey...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What thoughts are going into this song...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What do I want it to convey...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm still not exactly sure what kind of song it's gonna be, but I think I'm starting to get a better idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, Sakki!
I know your song's gonna be really amazing♪
